pain_points.name: Finding Quality Candidates
pain_points.description: Spending hours searching LinkedIn and job boards for qualified candidates
pain_points.impact: 40-60% of recruiter time spent on sourcing vs relationship building
pain_points.ai_potential: AI matching and semantic search reduce sourcing time by 50%+

pain_points.name: Candidate Ghosting
pain_points.description: Candidates stop responding during the hiring process
pain_points.impact: 30-50% of candidates ghost, wasting recruiter time and client relationships
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated personalized nurturing keeps candidates engaged

pain_points.name: Interview Scheduling Complexity
pain_points.description: Coordinating schedules between candidates, clients, and panel interviewers
pain_points.impact: Hours per week on back-and-forth scheduling emails
pain_points.ai_potential: Self-service scheduling with panel coordination saves 80%+ time

pain_points.name: ATS Database Decay
pain_points.description: Candidate database becomes stale with outdated information
pain_points.impact: 50-70% of ATS data is outdated within 2 years
pain_points.ai_potential: Data enrichment and re-engagement campaigns keep database fresh
